effect.sun-moon: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
effect.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
effect.lets-go-pikachu-lets-go-eevee: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

short_effect.sun-moon: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.
short_effect.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.
short_effect.lets-go-pikachu-lets-go-eevee: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.

flavor_text.sun-moon: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.
